name: Delta County, CO
findings: Delta County has 144 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 39 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Delta County has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Delta County list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Delta County list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are public events so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 11 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.

confidence.text: Based on 11 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do social and fraternal organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?

observations.title: Religious organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 8 religious organizations here list public events, compared with about 3 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 42% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What role do religious organizations play in community life here? Who do they reach, and who might they miss?
